description_good_justification: The README opens with what the site is: the personal site and blog of Alexander Vassbotn Røyne-Helgesen, built by a small set of Node scripts and deployed to GitHub Pages: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: The README explains how to build the site, and the contributing guide how to ask questions, report bugs (GitHub issues) and contribute: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process (issues, pull requests, checks, sign-off): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution requirements, including coding style and the checks a change must pass: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
floss_license_justification: The code is MIT-licensed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE. The posts and the author's own assets are content, not software, and are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE-CONTENT
floss_license_osi_justification: The code is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved.
documentation_basics_justification: The README describes the requirements, how to build and check the site, and how to write a post: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development
documentation_interface_justification: The external interface is the set of npm scripts that build and check the site, each described in the README, and the front matter of a post: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#scripts
sites_https_justification: The repository is on GitHub over HTTPS, and the site is served by GitHub Pages with HTTPS enforced: https://phun-ky.net
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The site is actively maintained, with changes merged and deployed in October 2026: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
repo_track_justification: Git tracks every change, its author and when it was made: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Work in progress is on public branches and pull requests before it is merged: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls
version_unique_justification: The site has no releases: every merge to main is deployed, and each deploy is identified by its unique git commit, shown on the deploy run in GitHub Actions: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
version_semver_justification: The site is deployed continuously from main and has no version numbers; a website has no users who pick a version to install.
version_tags_justification: There are no releases to tag; each deploy is identified by its commit on main.
release_notes_justification: The site has no releases: every change is a pull request with a description of what it changes, deployed when it is merged. The merged pull requests are the record of changes: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
release_notes_vulns_justification: There are no releases, and no publicly known vulnerability has been fixed. A fix would be described in a GitHub security advisory, as the security policy says: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported as GitHub issues with a bug report template: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
report_responses_justification: Every bug report in the last year has been acknowledged and labelled by the maintainer; the issues are public: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: Every enhancement request in the last year has been answered, and decisions are recorded in the issue: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The security policy describes how to report a vulnerability and how reports are handled: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Reports can be sent privately with GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email to security@phun-ky.net: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. The policy is to acknowledge a report within 7 days: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the site into dist/: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses Node.js and npm scripts.
build_floss_tools_justification: The site is built with Node.js, npm and open source npm packages only.
test_justification: The site is checked as it is built, with checks that are open source and in the repository: links, metadata, the Content Security Policy, accessibility with axe on every page in Chrome, layout at three widths and performance budgets: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#scripts
test_invocation_justification: Each check is an npm script (npm run check:*), listed in the README: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#scripts
test_most_justification: The checks cover the whole build: every page is loaded in Chrome and checked for requests to other hosts, Content Security Policy violations, horizontal scrolling and accessibility, and every internal link, page title, description and policy is checked.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs every check on every pull request and push to main; the check job is required before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New functionality must come with a check that covers it, and a fix with a check that fails without it where one can be written: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with checks: the fix for indented code in old posts added check:posts, the accessibility fixes added axe on every page, and the metadata work added check:metadata: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
tests_documented_added_justification: The contributing guide says which checks a change must come with: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
warnings_justification: ESLint (eslint-config-phun-ky) lints the JavaScript and the Markdown, and Prettier checks formatting.
warnings_fixed_justification: The code has no ESLint warnings or errors; the lint step fails on any.
warnings_strict_justification: npm run lint fails on any ESLint warning (--max-warnings 0), and lint and formatting errors fail the required check job.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: no server and nothing stored, nothing loaded from other hosts, a strict Content Security Policy with hashes for inline code, least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions and deploys only after the checks pass: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: cross-site scripting (a hash-based Content Security Policy on every page, checked in a browser), third-party content and tracking (nothing from other hosts, checked in CI), and supply chain (locked and reviewed dependencies, pinned Actions, dependency review): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_published_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no accounts, forms or server. HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

delivery_mitm_justification: The site is delivered by GitHub Pages with HTTPS enforced, and the repository by GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies package integrity from the lockfile and registry over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known vulnerabilities of medium or higher severity. The one open alert is low severity, in a development dependency that the build does not use, and is tracked in the security policy: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the site or its dependencies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The project uses no credentials, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses the JavaScript and the workflows on every pull request, push to main and weekly, and ESLint runs on every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL looks for common vulnerabilities in JavaScript, such as cross-site scripting and incomplete sanitisation.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL findings are fixed before merging; an error or a high or critical alert blocks the merge. For example, its incomplete sanitisation alerts in the description and figure code were fixed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every pull request and push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: check:browser loads every page in Chrome on every pull request and fails on Content Security Policy violations, requests to other hosts, horizontal scrolling and axe accessibility violations: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/scripts/checks/browser.mjs
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All the code is JavaScript, which is memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The site's scripts run without extra assertions in the browser checks; the checks themselves fail on what they find.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Problems found by the browser checks are fixed before merging, such as the accessibility violations axe found when it was added: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pull/186
